features.name: Server Bootstrap & HTTP Entry
features.description: Node HTTP server entrypoint (main) that wires config, tool loading, crews, routes, and both agent + monitor schedulers into a single running service

features.name: API Gateway & Route Registration
features.description: Central route registration (registerRoutes) mounting all API endpoints, request body parsing, JSON replies, and the GET /api/health liveness endpoint

features.name: API Token Authentication
features.description: Token-gated API access with constant-time token comparison (safeTokenEqual), per-request checkApiToken, and a test-only token cache reset hook

features.name: Configuration & LLM Provider Resolution
features.description: Project config loader (ROOT, PORT) with provider config loading and resolveLLM for selecting LLM provider settings

features.name: LLM Client
features.description: callLLM client with retries, streaming support (handleStream), tool-call merging, and fallback provider override logic

features.name: Tool Engine LLM Provider Adapter
features.description: OpenAI-compatible provider adapter (createProviderAdapter) with deterministic request serialization and LLM stream logging for tool-side model calls

features.name: Agent Loop
features.description: Tool-calling agent runtime: runAgentLoop and runAgentLoopStream with system prompt building, message trimming, and crew tool resolution

features.name: Crew System
features.description: Crew definition loader (loadAllCrews, getCrew, listCrews) exposing crew presets to chat and scheduled runs

features.name: Tool Registry & Loader
features.description: Dynamic tool loading from the tools/ tree (safeResolve, loadAllTools, wrappedHandler) plus the ToolRegistry that tools register into; exposed via GET /api/tools

features.name: Docs & Runbook Search Tool
features.description: Agent tool that parses frontmatter, scans runbooks/docs directories, and serves search queries over them

features.name: Grafana Tool
features.description: Grafana integration tool: auth header handling, GraphQL/API base resolution, time parsing, and table formatting for dashboards and queries

features.name: Kubernetes Tool
features.description: Kubectl wrapper tool with base arg building, destructive-command detection, and output truncation for safe cluster operations

features.name: Loki Logs Tool
features.description: Loki log querying tool with base URL/header construction, log result formatting, and stats result formatting

features.name: Prometheus Tool
features.description: Prometheus tool supporting instant and range queries plus alert listing, with response formatting for each query type

features.name: Security Audit Tool
features.description: Security scanning tool running RBAC scans, SSL checks, and dependency scans via subprocess commands with binary availability detection

features.name: Shell Tool
features.description: Guarded shell execution tool with blocked-pattern detection, safety/destructive checks, command runner, and output truncation

features.name: TChat Messaging Tool
features.description: Outbound messaging transport (tchat contract v0 / Telegram-style): config loading, sendMessage client, auth check, message formatting, and sendTchatMessage used by both schedulers for notifications

features.name: Conversation Persistence
features.description: Conversation store with load/save, archive and list/load of archives, ID sanitization, and directory bootstrapping

features.name: Agent Management (Store & API)
features.description: Agent CRUD store with cron validation, tool selection, and filename-safe IDs; exposed via the agents API including manual run trigger (TASK-006)

features.name: Agent Cron Scheduler
features.description: node-cron scheduling engine for agents: register/reschedule agents, executeScheduledRun with crew building and trigger messages, run timeout resolution, tchat notification delivery, and active schedule introspection

features.name: Task Store & API
features.description: In-memory TaskStore (id generation via crypto) backing the tasks API for create and list

features.name: Datasource Management
features.description: Datasource CRUD with URL/token/settings validation, token masking, atomic writes, and syncToolConfig that projects datasource settings into tool config files

features.name: Run History & Retention
features.description: Run recording store: startRun/finishRun lifecycle, tool-call normalization, deterministic sorted listing (tie-break on run id, TASK-004), getRun lookup, and retention-based pruning of old runs

features.name: Chat API
features.description: POST /api/chat endpoint running the agent loop against a selected crew with tool-call callbacks, conversation persistence, and task interaction

features.name: Monitor Flow Templates
features.description: Library of monitoring flow templates (STANDARD_SRE_FLOW, ALERT_TRIAGE_FLOW, RELEASE_WATCH_FLOW) with default monitor prompts, rules, skills, and template lookup/listing

features.name: Monitor Store & Monitor API
features.description: Monitor CRUD with schedule presets (presetToCron), source/output normalization, and the monitor routes handler dispatching monitor workspace endpoints (meta, list, create) with chat crew building and run summaries

features.name: Monitor Instance State
features.description: Per-monitor persistent instance state: getInstance/peek/update, run recording, incident append, knowledge setting, destroy, and state file listing with disk persistence

features.name: Monitor Scheduler & Run Execution
features.description: Monitor execution engine: executeMonitorRun with monitor crew building, per-source tool reads, signal detection, conversation + run recording, tchat notification, and cron-based rescheduling with next-run computation

features.name: Monitor Workspace UI
features.description: SRE Agentic Monitoring workspace page with monitor list, create-monitor modal, model settings modal, status pills, and live run/last-run display (MVP per spec)

features.name: Agents Page UI
features.description: Agent management page (upgraded from TaskManagementPage, TASK-003): agent list, create/edit form with cron and tool picker, enabled switch, and status banners

features.name: Console Page UI
features.description: Console chat page with markdown (react-markdown + remark-gfm) rendering for agent conversation output

features.name: Home Dashboard UI
features.description: Landing dashboard page with stat cards summarizing system state via fetched API data

features.name: Tools Directory UI
features.description: Tools listing page showing available agent tools and their metadata

features.name: App Shell & Navigation
features.description: React app entry and shell: App routing across pages, Sidebar navigation with StatusBadge, Placeholder page for unbuilt routes, and Vite build config (pinned 5.4.21)

features.name: UI Shared Types & Helpers
features.description: Shared frontend types and helpers: empty agent draft, client-side cron validation, lines/text conversion, provider lookup, and uptime formatting

features.name: Test Infrastructure
features.description: Vitest configuration for the monorepo and React Testing Library setup for UI tests

features.name: Grafana Mock Server
features.description: Development fixture Grafana server (TASK-008) serving health, search, dashboard, ds/query, rules, alerts, and datasources endpoints with generated series/rule data

features.name: TChat Mock Server
features.description: Development tchat mock server (port 3002, TASK-009) implementing contract v0 POST /api/messages with scenario switching, reset, sent-log inspection, and jsonl persistence via TCHAT_SENT_LOG

features.name: Watchdog E2E Test
features.description: End-to-end watchdog test (TASK-010) that boots the stack against the tchat mock with a scripted LLM responder, drives monitoring/alert flow, and asserts sent messages from the jsonl log; also exercises Grafana handler and task-state sync

features.name: Legacy SRE Console & Dashboard
features.description: Standalone SREConsole and SREDashboard views (provider card, alert card, quick-query panel) composing AgentConsole — not wired into the current ui/src App router; superseded by the page-based shell (AgentsPage upgrade, TASK-003)
